name: getLocaleDisplayName
description:
Gets a locale value and displays the name in a manner
that is appropriate to a specific locale. By default,
gets the current locale in the current locale's language.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale to use instead of the locale of the page when processing the function

params.name: dspLocale
params.description: The locale in which to return the name. The default is the locale defined for the request.
